action_items: (OPTIONAL/DESIGN) Consider replacing browser-native <input type='date'> for Tanggal Progres and other date inputs with shadcn Calendar+Popover for a consistent UX (same finding as iter7).

(OPTIONAL/A11Y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all DialogContent components. Warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' appears in console when Progres dialog opens.
(OPTIONAL/CODE QUALITY) server.py still ~1800+ lines - break into routes/ and models/ modules.

(OPTIONAL/BEHAVIOR) In Manual mode qty_masuk=0 so all 4 stages get zeroed by _cap on backend even though the UI shows the values entered. Users may be surprised. Consider either: (a) don't clamp when po_id is empty (allow manual free-form), or (b) show explicit UI notice that manual entries won't persist stage values without linking to a PO. The current backend zeros them silently.
(OPTIONAL/SPK MODEL) SPK items still typed List[Dict[str, Any]] - untyped. Iter7 recommendation.
critical_code_review_comments: ProgresBarang.jsx line 253: `max={manual ? undefined : maxQty || undefined}` - when manual mode is on, no client cap. Given backend zeros the values in manual mode (because qty_masuk=0 without po_id), the UX is confusing: user types values but they persist as 0. Either the backend should NOT clamp for manual mode, or the frontend should show a stronger warning that 'without PO you cannot record stage quantities'.

server.py update_progres (line ~776-790): The comment 'packing ≤ finishing ≤ servis ≤ grinda ≤ qty_masuk' is stated but NOT enforced - each stage is independently capped at qty_masuk only. If business logic actually requires the pipeline ordering (packing shouldn't exceed finishing, etc.), this needs to be added. If not, remove the misleading comment.

server.py update_progres does `doc.pop('_id', None)` after upsert (line 817) but the doc was constructed manually without _id in the first place - the pop is defensive but unnecessary. Note: `insert_one` mutates the passed dict to include _id (ObjectId). The pop removes ObjectId (which is non-JSON-serializable). Behavior is correct now but relies on mutation side-effect.
get_progres_by_po (server.py ~821): still iterates all PO/BM/progres collections (O(N)) per request. For scale, consider aggregation pipeline or caching.

ProgresBarang.jsx: filterTanggal only affects PDF export URL, not the list display. Users may expect filterTanggal to filter the visible items too - current UX shows filter next to filter-po but only PDF respects it. Consider clarifying label to 'Filter Tanggal (PDF only)'.
test_iter8.py class-scoped fixtures defined as instance methods trigger PytestRemovedIn10Warning - cosmetic; consider @classmethod for future-proofing.

ProgresBarang.jsx line 62: `const maxQty = manual ? Infinity : currentQtyMasuk;` - Infinity used as sentinel but the ternary on line 253 uses `manual ? undefined : maxQty || undefined` making maxQty=Infinity dead code in the max attribute path. Simplify.
DialogContent (all pages) missing DialogDescription - repeat a11y warning.
